scenario_description:
Objective: Complete an already-started exhibitor check-in for Mara’s STEM fair project before the morning intake window closes.
Emerging Need: The kiosk session opens successfully, then the badge scan is paused because an online profile-holder e-waiver is missing and no desk override is available.
Decision Context: Early scheduling and availability notes do not justify interrupting anyone; the pause notice supplies the session code and deadline, while a stored portal note identifies the only guardian account that can unblock it.
Consequence: Timely coordination can resume the same kiosk session; after it expires, the project cannot enter today’s fair.

parameter.title: Mara STEM fair project check-in
parameter.description: Drop off Mara and her project board at exhibitor intake; badge activation happens at the lobby kiosk.
parameter.location: Evanston Civic Center lobby, 2100 Ridge Ave

parameter.content: I’m in Noah’s orthodontist waiting room from 8:30 to 9:00. I can tap one quick portal item if something comes through, but I won’t be able to call the fair desk.

parameter.subject: Kiosk session opened for Mara Moreno
parameter.body: Lobby kiosk session ESF-883 opened at 8:35 AM for Mara Moreno. Project category: Junior Inventions. Keep this session active until badge activation is complete.

parameter.subject: Badge activation paused for session ESF-883
parameter.body: Session ESF-883 is PAUSED. The badge scan cannot continue because the exhibitor profile holder has not completed today’s e-waiver. Volunteer override is not available. Use https://portal.evanstonstemfair.example/waiver with code ESF-883 before the kiosk session expires at 9:05 AM; exhibitor intake closes at 9:15 AM.

parameter.subject: Kiosk session ESF-883 expired
parameter.body: Kiosk session ESF-883 expired at 9:05 AM without badge activation. New exhibitor sessions are now locked for today’s fair intake, and the desk cannot admit projects that did not activate before the session cutoff.
